def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    rice_patches = image_patch.find("rice")
    poop_patches = image_patch.find("poop")
    
    if not rice_patches or not poop_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    rice_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2] for p in rice_patches]
    poop_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2] for p in poop_patches]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    closest_rice = None
    
    for rice_center in rice_centers:
        for poop_center in poop_centers:
            dx = rice_center[0] - poop_center[0]
            dy = rice_center[1] - poop_center[1]
            distance = math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
            if distance < min_distance:
                min_distance = distance
                closest_rice = rice_patches[rice_centers.index(rice_center)]
    
    return closest_rice
